hero.title: The client doesn't wait. Neither do you.
hero.subtitle: The dispatch platform for taxi and transfer businesses where punctuality matters. Assign rides, track drivers in real time, and coordinate airport pickups.

problem.title: Dispatching with paper and phone costs you clients
problem.subtitle: For time-critical business clients, minutes decide. These four gaps make the difference.

items.title: No live arrival time
items.desc: The client doesn't know when the driver arrives — and calls instead of waiting.

items.title: Airport pickups are painful
items.desc: Name boards, phone tag, searching at the terminal. Expensive parking minutes.

items.title: Information is scattered
items.desc: Ride, client and driver data live in chats, notes and people's heads.

items.title: No reminders
items.desc: Missed pickups because nobody was reminded in time.

features.title: Everything for the on-time transfer
features.subtitle: From request to pickup — built for small and medium transport businesses.

primary.title: Manual dispatch
primary.desc: Pending requests at a glance, assign drivers in one click. Travel-time validation via Google, conflict detection included.

primary.title: Airport coordination
primary.desc: Real-time location sharing, geofence for optimal entry. Lower parking costs, faster meetups at the terminal.

primary.title: Live tracking & ETA
primary.desc: Driver position and arrival time live for the client. The client sees when the car is coming.

secondary.title: Tenant isolation
secondary.desc: Every company sees only its own data. Strict separation by CompanyId — secure and GDPR-compliant.

secondary.title: Reports & metrics
secondary.desc: Rides, revenue and distance driven at a glance. Visibility across the whole operation.

how.title: Four steps to an on-time ride

steps.title: Capture the request
steps.desc: Secretary, dispatcher, driver or client creates the ride.

steps.title: Assign a driver
steps.desc: The dispatcher assigns the right shift — with a travel-time check.

steps.title: Coordinate live
steps.desc: Driver and client share location, see ETA and meeting point.

steps.title: Complete
steps.desc: Finish the ride; metrics flow automatically into the report.

items.title: Lower parking costs
items.desc: Geofence coordination at the airport — enter only when the client is actually there.

items.title: Faster meetups
items.desc: Real-time location sharing instead of phone tag and name boards.

items.title: More loyal clients
items.desc: Live ETA and driver details build trust with business clients.

items.title: Operations in view
items.desc: Reports, metrics and automatic reminders for the whole day.
